checks.text: With no entries the page shows the heading "Subscription Tracker", the text "No subscriptions yet", and the summary line "Total monthly: $0.00".

Filling the field labelled "Name" with "Netflix", choosing "Streaming" in the select labelled "Category", typing "15.99" in the field labelled "Monthly cost", and clicking the button "Add subscription" adds a row containing "Netflix", "Streaming", and "$15.99"; the summary shows "Total monthly: $15.99" and "No subscriptions yet" is gone.
After also adding a subscription with Name "Spotify", Category "Music", and Monthly cost "10.45", a row contains "Spotify", "Music", and "$10.45", and the summary shows "Total monthly: $26.44".
Clicking "Add subscription" with an empty Name, or with a Monthly cost that is empty, 0, or negative, adds no row and shows the message "Enter a name and a cost greater than 0".
Every row has a button named "Delete <name>". With the subscriptions Netflix 15.99 and Spotify 10.45, clicking "Delete Spotify" removes that row and the summary shows "Total monthly: $15.99".

Typing "123.456" in the field labelled "Monthly cost" and clicking "Add subscription" with Name "Test" and Category "Other" adds a row showing "$123.46" and the summary shows "Total monthly: $123.46".
Clicking the column header labelled "Name" sorts the rows by name ascending; with subscriptions "Netflix" and "Spotify", "Netflix" appears before "Spotify".
Clicking the column header labelled "Monthly cost" sorts the rows by cost descending; with subscriptions "Netflix" 15.99 and "Spotify" 10.45, "Netflix" appears before "Spotify".
Reload keeps the subscription "Netflix" with the text "$15.99" and the summary line "Total monthly: $15.99".
